scene: Inferno VIII — Filippo Argenti and the closed gates of Dis
source: Dante Inferno VIII, after the ferry boarding through the barred gates
story: From the ferry on the Styx, a mud-covered spirit challenges Dante and is recognized as Filippo Argenti
The hostility escalates; Argenti reaches for the boat, and Virgil repels him
Dante says he wishes to see Argenti suffer; Virgil praises Dante's reaction, raising a moral interpretive tension rather than certifying a chemical result
Other wrathful souls attack Argenti while the travelers proceed
Dante sees the glowing red towers and walls of the City of Dis
Fallen angels at Dis refuse entrance, and the gates are shut against Virgil; passage is not achieved in this stage
